column1: # gates/held-trees.tsv - THE REGISTER OF GATED-GREEN TREES THAT MUST NOT SHIP.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A "GATES GREEN" log says the gate suite passed over a bundle. It does NOT say that the
# tree shipped, or that it may. At 2026-10-01T00:31Z a run looking for a way out of a deadlock found a
# gated-green ancestor, ran every mechanical check this project provides, got four greens, and pushed a tree
# that #441 had deliberately held. All four checks were correct and none of them could see the hold:
#   git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main e765135          -> true
#   gates/verify-log.sh .../441-all.log '#441'                -> OK (47 suites, 3097 PASS, footer agrees)
#   git show e765135:app.js | md5sum                          -> a4df39c38222, the md5 that log's footer names
#   git show e765135 --stat                                   -> adds only the log file
# The only warning in existence was one sentence in a prose table cell on an unmerged branch: RUN-LOG.md:247 ON
# origin/claude/cool-noether-gccllp, reading "then stood down on two P0s from the adversarial pass" - which no
# tool reads and which main does not even carry. NAME THE TREE WHEN YOU CITE THAT LINE: both of #450's
# antagonists independently called this citation dangling, because line 247 OF MAIN is #437's job-counting rule,
# and the citation is exactly right on the tree where the sentence lives. One line number meaning two different
# things on two trees is not a footnote, it IS the defect.
# The push was reverted 17 minutes later by its own antagonist pass.
# Filed as jobs/a-gated-green-log-is-not-a-shippable-tree-2026-10-01 (P0, priority 11). This file is its fix.
# WHAT MAKES THIS A GUARD AND NOT A NOTE. It is keyed on things a LATER run can compute from the artefact it is
# holding, with no network and no tracker: the BUNDLE MD5 and the GATED SHA. gates.sh writes both into every log
# IT WRITES (the header line carries "md5 <hex>", the ref line carries "ref: HEAD <sha> | bundle md5 <hex>"), and
# `md5sum app.js` recovers the first from any tree on disk.
# BUT NOT INTO EVERY LOG THAT EXISTS, and the first draft of this paragraph said "every log", which antagonist B
# measured and disproved: the ref line arrived at #417, and 52 OF THE 81 COMMITTED GATELOGS (64%) carry no
# `ref: HEAD` line at all. verify-log.sh skips the sha comparison when it is absent, so ON MOST OF THIS
# PROJECT'S LOG CORPUS ONLY THE MD5 ARM FIRES. Said plainly because a guard's coverage is not a detail.
# gates/verify-log.sh reads this file BY DEFAULT and
# REFUSES a log naming a held bundle or a held sha. Nothing here is self-reported by the run that wants to push:
# the row is written by the run that HELD the tree, and read by a different run later. This project has recorded
# six separate defects whose single cause was that the check and the thing being checked were the same object;
# a `shippable` field written by the pushing run would have been the seventh.
# HOW TO WRITE A ROW. `gates/held.sh add <bundleMd5> <gatedSha> <#NNN> <reason...>` - or append by hand. Do it in
# THE SAME step as the stand-down, before the run ends, and commit it to MAIN rather than to the per-run branch:
# #441's own warning was lost precisely because it lived only on a branch that never merged, and a reverted
# commit takes its log with it. A row costs one line and survives a container being reclaimed.
# HOW TO CLEAR A ROW. Do NOT delete it. A tree does not become shippable by being forgotten. Change the first
# field to a `-` prefix (e.g. `-a4df39c38222`), which stops it matching, and append to the reason why it was
# cleared, with the sha that superseded it. The history is the useful part.
# A LIMIT OF THE FIRST TWO KEYS, MEASURED AT #450 RATHER THAN LEFT FOR SOMEONE TO FIND. `gates/build.sh:14`
# builds the stamp as `$N - $(TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') ET` and embeds it with
# `--define:__BUILD__`, so THE BUNDLE MD5 CHANGES ON EVERY REBUILD IN A NEW MINUTE even from byte-identical
# source. Both bundleMd5 and gatedSha therefore identify an ARTEFACT, not a source tree: a run that REBUILDS a
# held source tree and commits it gets a fresh md5 and a fresh sha and matches neither. That is not the failure
# this register was written for - the 00:31Z push took an EXISTING gated-green tree, where both keys match - and
# a rebuild has to earn its own green suite anyway. But it is a real hole, so there is a seventh field:
# sourceMd5, `git show <sha>:chess.jsx | md5sum | cut -c1-12`, which is stamp-independent and survives a
# rebuild. `gates/held.sh check` compares it against the working tree's chess.jsx, and SO DOES `verify-log.sh`,
# via the sha on the log's own ref line. THIS PARAGRAPH FIRST SAID verify-log.sh "CANNOT use it and does not
# try", which antagonist A disproved in the same build: that script already reads the working tree for
# --this-bundle, and `git show <ref sha>:chess.jsx | md5sum` is reachable from the log alone. The false version
# is recorded because A's point was that a wrong sentence here is worse than the gap - it tells the next run not
# to bother. ITS OWN LIMIT, also A's: this is an EXACT-BLOB key, so it catches a straight carry-forward of the
# held source (four commits carry #441's chess.jsx byte-identical) and dies the moment one unrelated character
# changes. No key in this register tracks the DEFECT itself; that needs a predicate, and it is filed as
# jobs/a-held-row-should-carry-a-predicate-not-only-a-hash-2026-10-01.
# sourceMd5 is OPTIONAL - older rows and rows whose sha is unreachable may leave it `-`.
# FORMAT: tab-separated. bundleMd5 (first 12 hex, as gates.sh writes it) | gatedSha, COMMA-SEPARATED - every
# sha that names this tree, not only the gated one | build | heldAt
# (ISO-8601 UTC) | heldBy (runId) | reason (one sentence, the specific thing the suite could not see) |
# sourceMd5 (first 12 hex of chess.jsx at that sha, or `-`).
# bundleMd5

column6: HELD ON TWO P0s THE SUITE CANNOT SEE. TWO FIELDS OF THIS ROW WERE FABRICATED IN ITS FIRST DRAFT AND ARE CORRECTED HERE, because this register's whole thesis is that a later run trusts a row it did not write: heldBy read build__1790770888628 only after #450's antagonist A proved the first value, build__1790730000000, appears in no commit, no RUN-LOG row and no HANDOFF and decodes to 2026-09-30T01:00:00Z, fourteen hours before #441's first commit - and the real runId was in a tracker document #450 had already read; and heldAt read 2026-09-30T16:05Z, which matches no commit in the window. Both are now read from git log --format=%cI and from the #441 runledger row. Backfilled by build__1790832010925 (#450) from tracker artifact 5326ERvZCZ5tEYRkPavPTF collection builds doc 441, and re-measured against the sha itself rather than copied; `builds/441` is a TRACKER document, not a path in this repository. THE FIX EXISTS ON origin/claude/cool-noether-gccllp AND THAT BRANCH IS NOT A REMEDY YOU CAN JUST TAKE: measured 2026-10-01, it is DIVERGED from main, 18 ahead AND 7 BEHIND, so it is not a fast-forward and taking it loses or re-merges seven of main's commits including #449's gate 68; and NO gate log in this repository has ever run against the pile head (grep of claude/agents/gatelogs/ for its sha 4307c97 and its bundle md5 0bbc5c85b1df returns nothing). See jobs/the-sel-cls-split-migrated-selectors-but-not-every-label-consumer-2026-09-30 and jobs/a-red-pile-head-is-not-a-red-pile-2026-10-01. The second sha is the commit actually PUSHED and reverted; keying only on the gated sha made `held.sh check e765135` answer 'not held'.

GATES GREEN at 47 sections / 3208 PASS / 0 fail, and antagonist B VETOED it from the shipped-surface door. The suite could not see it because no assertion read the text of the one control this build added: the 44px Hide button rendered its label as the six literal characters of an escape sequence instead of the glyph, 46.7px of ink through a 44px circle, running 1.7px off the right edge of the screen at 375 wide and 3.9px at 320, with no ellipsis - and the header sentence teaching the control said the same. That string is first in the banner, so it would have been in every screenshot Kunal sent back. M5b/M6/M7 asserted the control exists, is 44x44, takes pointer events, sits inside the viewport and clears the banner when tapped, and all five were green over it. Superseded by bundle 4dd3b4aa09ed, which fixes both sites and adds M9/M9b/M10 to pin the class.

This is the #442-#447 pile head, origin/claude/cool-noether-4vmw7f at 004cb86, 19 ahead of main and 22 behind. It carries the win-probability ladder Kunal DID rule on (Desk q-classify-on-winprob, choice labels-and-accuracy, 2026-09-28) plus the two P0 fixes #441 was held for and gates 66 and 67. IT CANNOT SHIP IN EITHER STATE. WITH the #441 mate floor, gates/regress/66-winprob-ladder.js:164 goes red: B1 asserts grade.Blunder.b===0 for the mated player while the floor sends a move that newly forces mate against the mover to classify(Infinity), and in PGN_OPERA Black's 15...Nxd7 allows 16.Qb8+ Nxb8 17.Rd8#, so the floor fires on exactly the move B1 says is not a blunder. WITHOUT the floor it is option (ii) of three Kunal must choose between, which is what #450 pushed as e765135 and had reverted 17 minutes later at 364f700. INSTRUMENT, stated because this project keeps publishing numbers without their grain: derived from the text of both files at this one sha, NOT from a browser run, and corroborated by c9db4cd ('#441: the tree is RED on gate 66') and 379857b ('#445run close-out: the no-floor control is NOT green'). NO GATE LOG HAS EVER RUN AGAINST THIS BUNDLE - grep of claude/agents/gatelogs for 0bbc5c85b1df and 004cb86 returns nothing - so unlike the rows above this is not a gated green being withheld; there is no green to withhold. CLEARING THIS ROW NEEDS ONE SENTENCE FROM KUNAL, not a re-gate.
